mla_hasfacesT_6bit.prc

Two unit cubes, each its own compressed tessellation of 12 triangles in 6
faces, normals recalculated, one flat colour per face, the second cube at
x + 2. Written by a nanoPRC writer changed for this purpose in one place:
is_multiple_line_attribute is stored TRUE, followed by one
is_multiple_line_attribute_on_face entry per face, each 0 (a single line
attribute on the face). has_faces is TRUE and is_point_color_on_face has one
entry per face, as the writer stores them.

Two cubes, so that a reader that takes the wrong number of
is_multiple_line_attribute_on_face entries in the first reads the second out
of step.

Used by tests/unit/test_multiple_line_attribute_on_face.c.
